spec.root_selection: timing-only pilot selects 1 or 2 time-spaced scheduled student decisions per seed; target 0/10000 if two, nearest5000 if one; all-candidate labels never used for root selection
spec.scope_resolution: retain six non-L45 marked points with original teacher prefixes; >10000 ticks are explicit named-point exceptions; two L45 points deferred under explicit final sentence of appendix B
spec.candidates: all engine legal planting AND shovels plus canonical wait:60/timeout; root shovel outcomes remain separate from production representable candidates
spec.terminal_policy: immediately after candidate, same frozen search teacher all the way to terminal; world and search noise common across root candidates
spec.pilot: first seed per ordinary level, initial/nearest5000 roots plus marked points; one future, representative first/middle/last cells per plant packet + one shovel + wait; only CPU timing used
spec.sampling_budget_gate: freeze root density and sample count after pilot CPU projections, preserving all legal candidates and >=2 seeds per level; reserve >=1200 CPU seconds for audits/repro/report
spec.uncertainty: small common-future cohort; strict/tie/thresholded rankings and reset-seed clusters; observed improvements do not imply independent significance

timing_amendment.reason: all four projections exceeded 20h; original two-root choice includes near10000 but original timing pilot covered initial/near5000 only; measure already-inspected end roots before declaring infeasible

cpu_sparse_fallback.reason: all original options exceed 20h after both timing cohorts; original point density was not a user requirement
cpu_sparse_fallback.rule: six named non-L45 roots cover their own reset seed; for each remaining level/reset seed choose one scheduled legal student point in 0..10000 minimizing candidate_count * nearest same-level mean measured CPU, ties by decision
cpu_sparse_fallback.preserve: all seven levels, two reset seeds each, six named roots, every legal plant/shovel/wait action, frozen terminal teacher
cpu_sparse_fallback.limitation: CPU-selected sparse points do not estimate all opening decisions or phase-wide policy performance

inference_limit: Only preregistered root/common-future cohort; report wins/wave/tick separately. Terminal continuation is frozen teacher, short v4 leaf is 2500-tick student.
